greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lwenkosi yethu uYesu Kristu lube nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi. Kristu, ube nenceba kuthi. Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi.
psalm_response: INkosi ingumalusi wam; andisayi kuswela nto.
homily:
Kukho imizuzu apho ubomi bujongeka njengendawo apho sifumana khona izinto ezincinci, eziqhelekileyo, kodwa ezithwala ubunzima obukhulu bentliziyo. Cinga nje ngomfanekiso oqhelekileyo: iinqwelo-moya ezincinci zephepha okanye ikhadi elinomfanekiso wenqwelo-moya ebekwe phezu kwetafile. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayeyithanda kakhulu le nto. Wayengumfana owayejonga phezulu, engaboni nje ubumnyama okanye amafu, kodwa ebona amathuba. Wayeyindoda encinci eyayinezixhobo zokuqonda ikamva, eyayibona ukuba ubomi bunokubhabha kude, bunokufikelela kwiindawo ezintsha, kwaye bunokuba yinto enkulu kunokuba singayicinga apha emhlabeni. UBen wayengumfana owayephethe ukukhanya okukhulu, enqwenela ukubona izinto zihamba kakuhle kwabo bonke abamngqongileyo.

Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo yobomi, sibona uThixo esithi: 'Imiphefumlo yamalungisa isesandleni sikaThixo.' Masiyimele kancinci le mfanekiso… Awuthethi ngabantu abambalwa abakhethekileyo kuphela; uthetha ngesihlwele esikhulu, esingenakubalwa mntu, esiphakathi kokukhanya kukaThixo. UBenjamin Vo, uBen wethu omncane owayenentliziyo ethambileyo nencumayo, ngoku umi phakathi kweso sihlwele. Uphakathi kwabo bahlambulula iingubo zabo ezindaweni zegazi leWana, abasindileyo exesheni lentshabalalo enkulu, abaphumla kukhanya kukaThixo ongunaphakade.

Kodwa ukuthetha ngabo bonke abangcwele, nokuthetha ngabo bafikayo ekhaya kuThixo, kusizisa kwiinyaniso ezinzima zeli hlabathi apho thina sisaphila khona. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu, zikushiya ungazi nokuba ume ngaphi. Kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen, okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise, okanye ukubona izinto ezincinci ezifana nezinto zakhe zokusebenza, kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kwaye kukho amaxesha apho ukuziva uwedwa kuhlasela ngaphandle kwesaziso.

Mamela le nyaniso namhlanje, mhlawumbi ngendlela odinga ngayo ukuyiva ngoku: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula kwabantwana, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo onzima kakhulu wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthi: 'Yonke into uYise ayinika mna iya kuza kum, kwaye andisayi kumgxotha nabani na oza kum.' Masiyimele kancinci le mfanekiso… UYesu akathethi nje ngendlela ehleka ngayo eli hlabathi; uthetha ngendlela kaThixo apho ukubandezeleka kungapheliyo ekungenamvuzo, kodwa apho iinyembezi ziguqulwa zibe nguvuyo. UBen wayengumfana owayenenhliziyo ehlambulukileyo, owayebonisa ububele obukhulu. Khumbula indlela awayenothando ngayo, indlela awayefuna ngayo ukunikela ngako konke okwakhe ngenxa yabanye, kanye njengaloo mzuzu awayefuna ngayo ukunikela ngemali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange aphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali leyo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe: umntwana owayeselula kodwa onentliziyo enkulu eyayifuna ukunceda wonke umntu.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakhe. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo.

Namhlanje, njengoko simi phambi kweLizwi likaThixo, masithathe isigqibo sokuba singoyiki ukukhumbula, singoyiki ukuthandaza. UBen usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndikholelwa ukuba ukhona ngokwenene kwiSakramente eNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngokomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ukhona, kwaye ndizimanyanisa ngokupheleleyo nawe. Ungandivumeli ndahlukane nawe nanini na. Amen.
closing: INkosi mayisikelele, isigcine, kwaye isikhanyisele ngobuso bayo ngalo lonke ixesha. Hamba noxolo lukaKristu.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abashiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abakhalayo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Imiphefumlo yamalungisa isesandleni sikaThixo, kwaye akukho ntuthumbo eya kuyichukumisa. Kubantu abaziziyatha, babonakala ngathi bafile; ukumka kwabo kwakucingelwa njengentlekele, nokuhamba kwabo phakathi kwethu, njengentshabalalo epheleleyo. Kodwa bona baphumla eluxolweni. Kuba ukuba phambi kwabantu babethwa, ithemba labo lizele kukungafi; beqeqeshwe kancinci, baya kusikelelwa kakhulu, kuba uThixo wabalinge wafumana ukuba bafanelekile kuye. Njengegolide eziko, wabalinge, kwaye njengeminikelo wabathatha waba ngabakhe. Ngexesha lokundwendwela kwakhe baya kukhanya, baya kutshiza njengamalangabi kukhula; baya kugweba iintlanga, balawule izizwe, kwaye iNkosi iya kuba nguKumkani wabo ngonaphakade. Abo bamthembayo baya kuqonda inyaniso, kwaye abathembekileyo baya kuhlala naye eluthandweni: kuba ubabalo nenceba zikwabo bangcwele bakhe, kwaye unonophelo lwakhe lukwabo banyuliweyo bakhe.

readings.label: Isifundo sesibini
readings.text: Bazalwana noodade wethu: Ithemba alidanisi, kuba uthando lukaThixo luthululwe ezintliziyweni zethu ngoMoya oyiNgcwele esiwunikiweyo. Kuba uKristu, ngelixa sasisenabuthathaka, wafela abangahloniphiyo uThixo ngexesha elimisiweyo. Enyanisweni, kunzima ukuba umntu afele ilungisa, nangona mhlawumbi umntu angaba nesibindi sokufela umntu olungileyo. Kodwa uThixo ubonakalisa uthando lwakhe kuthi, ngokuba ngelixa sasisengaboni, uKristu wasifela. Kakhulu kangakanani ke, ekubeni ngoku sithethelelwe ngeGazi lakhe, siya kusindiswa nguye kumsindo. Enyanisweni, ukuba ngelixa sasingabachasi, sacolwa noThixo ngokufa koNyana wakhe, kakhulu kangakanani ke, sakuba sicolwe, siya kusindiswa ngobomi bakhe. Akuphelelanga apho, kodwa siyazingca ngoThixo ngeNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu, esifumene ngaye ngoku ukucolwa.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kwisihlwele: 'Yonke into uYise ayinika mna iya kuza kum, kwaye andisayi kumgxotha nabani na oza kum, kuba ndehla ezulwini, kungekhona ukwenza intando yam, kodwa ukwenza intando yalowo undithumileyo. Kwaye le yintando yalowo undithumileyo, ukuba ndingalahlekelwa yinto yalo yonke endinikiweyo, kodwa ndiyivuse ngomhla wokugqibela. Kuba le yintando kaYise, ukuba wonke umntu obona uNyana akholwe kuye abe nobomi obungunaphakade, kwaye ndiya kumvusa ngomhla wokugqibela.'

day: The Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
